Create the API Source

Source: R/source.R
og_api.Rd

The API Source answers queries through the OpenGWAS API. Every query function takes a Source as its first argument.

Usage

og_api(
  url = getOption("opengwasr.url"),
  timeout = default_timeout(),
  max_in_flight = default_max_in_flight(),
  caller = NULL
)

Arguments

url

The API's base URL. Defaults to the opengwasr.url option, then OPENGWAS_URL.

timeout

Seconds to wait for any one call before giving up. Defaults to the opengwasr.timeout option, then 3600.

max_in_flight

How many Jobs one call may run at once. Defaults to the opengwasr.max_in_flight option, then 4; at most 100, the Jobs one user may have queued.

caller

A package or tool calling opengwasr on its users' behalf, to name itself in the user agent of every request this Source makes, so the API's logs can tell which tool made it: og_api(caller = "TwoSampleMR/0.8.0") sends opengwasr/<version> TwoSampleMR/0.8.0. One short string of printable characters (at most 100), name/version by convention; NULL (the default) adds nothing.

Value

An og_api_source.

Details

Credentials come from the environment: OPENGWAS_URL and OPENGWAS_DEV_KEY, with OPENGWAS_DEV_USER naming the user (default opengwasr-dev). This developer access reaches the Data API directly and is for developing opengwasr, not for analyses. The key is never printed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
src <- og_api()
src
} # }
